items.name: CM50001
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM53004
items.description: Sun Dual 10GbE SPF+ PCIe Low Profile
items.longDescription: Sun Dual Port 10 GbE SFP+ PCIe 2.0 networking card with SFP+ pluggable transceiver is designed for the need of the changing data center environments today. Ideal for slot-constrained environments, Sun Dual 10 GbE PCIe 2.0 card provides a simplified low cost alternative to multiple 1 GbE server adapters for Oracle's Sun portfolio of rack and blade servers.Today's multicore environments are driving the need for greater networking bandwidth in order to meet the throughput requirements for virtualized server environments. Offering advanced networking features for efficient distribution of Ethernet workloads across CPU cores, the Sun Dual Port 10 GbE PCIe 2.0 networking cards help to load-balance interrupts and relieve bottlenecks for various high-performance applications in the data center, including iSCSI implementation allowing LAN and storage traffic to share the same network.

items.name: CM53007
items.longDescription: Designed to offer maximum value, the Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter enables the efficient delivery of cost-effective network security to Oracle platforms running Oracle's Solaris operating system.Applications using the SSL protocol can increase transaction protection and performance from the Oracle crypto board. Capable of establishing SSL sessions at up to 13,000 RSA operations per second with 1,024-bit keys and more than 1 Gbps bulk encryption, the Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter efficiently offloads SSL functions and bulk encryption for any application - including IPSec from host processors.The Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter is FIPS 140-2 Level 3 qualified, which means the hardware is tamper protected and tamper evident, and that security parameters never leave the card unencrypted. The Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter provides a hardware key store enabling users to safeguard the security parameters on the card. The crypto board also supports financial services-related PIN and credit card verification functionality.

items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM550017
items.longDescription:
SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.

Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation 

SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.

The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.

The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.

Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.

The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: DPF1004
items.description: SONY BLACK - GLOSS 15 (16:10) 4 GB DIGITAL PHOTO FRAME 1280X1024 600:1 (NOT WALL MOUNTABLE)
items.longDescription: This 15 inch digital frame is ready to play your pictures and videos straight out of the box with our easy to use 'plug and play' design.  Featuring an inbuilt motion sensor, the frame will turn itself on when it senses any motion and off again when it senses no motion. The motion sensor is very easily set up and can be set to switch off after sensing no movement in time increments from 30 seconds to 1 hour. This frame is perfect for everyone from professionals to parents and grandparents who just want a frame that works with the convenience of not having to actually operate it. As well as its ease of use; the frame features a hi-res SVGA screen with LED back lighting. Importantly the frame will also play your MPEG-4 / .AVI video, JPEG photos. When the frame activates after sensing movement it can play either your photos (from where it left off in the slideshow) or videos. We've equipped it with a generous 4GB memory, housed in a very small and portable USB thumb drive so you can conveniently move photos from your computer to your frame.

items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.

Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation 

SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.

The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.

These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.

Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.

The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50001
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM550017
items.longDescription:
SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.

Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation 

SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.

The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.

The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.

Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.

The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM550017
items.longDescription:
SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.

Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation 

SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.

The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.

The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.

Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.

The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50000
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50000
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: Experience the same exquisite Italian espresso and cappuccino that is served in the world's finest restaurants. items.name: sku16450
items.description: Bonjour Milk Frother Caffe Froth Beaker Replacement
items.longDescription: Now you can whip even nonfat milk into creamy foam to top coffee and espresso drinks. Just put milk in the canister, agitate and voila! The froth is extra-thick because water droplets from steam don't dilute the milk. Works with hot or cold milk. Glass canister is microwave safe. Holds 14 ounces after frothing.

items.name: sku264648
items.longDescription: Clever design fuses Staub's signature colors with unique Japanese styling. Teapots include innovative details such as stainless steel handles that hold lids in place. Enameled cast iron heats evenly and quickly. Hand wash. Made in France. Lifetime warranty. 6 1/4" diam. 1 qt.

items.name: sku364349
items.longDescription: Brewing fresh espresso, cappuccino and cafe latte is a cinch. Programs automatically for a large or small cup. Automatic steam nozzle creates perfect hot milk froth. Machine switches off if opened during brewing.Electronic temperature regulation. 19-bar static pressure. Removable 42-ounce water tank. Includes set of two cups and assortment of 20 coffee capsules.

items.name: sku455782
items.longDescription: Featuring 19-bar high-pressure pump, manual coffee volume control and a handle that automatically ejects used capsules. Includes tray for used capsules. Espresso-only machine; no frothing/steaming wand. 1200 watts. 6 1/2" x 10" x 11 1/2". Weighs 6.6 lbs.

items.name: sku473538
items.longDescription: Designed for brewing loose teas, particularly whole-leaf teas - black, green, herb or oolong tea. The mesh bottom infuser gives you a perfect even brew every time, and it comes with an easy-to-grasp silicon-covered handle and lid. Pot and infuser dishwasher-safe. Pot is also microwave-safe

items.name: sku481259
items.longDescription: The perfect fusion of strength and beauty. Elegant hand-blown design with bamboo handle and footed base; stainless steel micromesh filter. Includes a bamboo tea scoop. Hand wash. By BonJour. 7 1/2" tall (handle up), 5 1/4" tall (handle down); 7 1/2" diam. 42 oz.

items.name: sku515890
items.longDescription: Made in England from tinned-lined solid copper. Perfect for either electric or gas stovetops, this flat-bottomed kettle transfers heat efficiently. The ebonized beech handle stays cool to the touch. Whistles on boil. Hand wash. 8 3/4" x 8 3/4" x 10"., 1 3/4-qt. capacity.

items.name: sku576876
items.longDescription: Striking modern design sets this tea kettle apart from its competitors. Made of enameled stainless steel for even, fast heat distribution, its flat base allows for efficient contact with burner. Features removable whistle and heat-resistant handle. Hand wash. 1 1/4-qt. capacity.

items.name: sku589721
items.description: illy iperEspresso Capsules, Medium Roast, 21 servings
items.longDescription: Effortlessly make a delicious, authentic Italian espresso from pre-measured, single-serving Arabica coffee capsules. The two-phase extraction results in a rich, smooth espresso with velvety, long-lasting crema. Capsules keep coffee from touching your machine, so there's no coffee oil buildup. Choose from four flavors: dark roast, medium roast, decaffeinated or lungo. For use exclusively with Francis Francis X7 for illy iperEspresso Capsule Machines.

items.name: sku591768
items.longDescription: Preserve the flavor and aroma of your coffee with the stainless steel blade and beaker that keep heat build-up to a minimum when grinding. Pulse action allows for a customized the grind to suit individual tastes. Clear safety lid and recessed cord storage in base. Large capacity for more than 15 cups of coffee.

items.name: sku610204
items.description: Nescafe Dolce Gusto by Krups Cappuccino Capsules
items.longDescription: Delicious coffee is easy to prepare and ready in just seconds with these capsules. Pre-measured capsules effortlessly slide into your Krups Nescafe Dolce Gusto system to make a delectable espresso, caffe lungo, cappuccino, latte macchiato or chococino. The capsules deliver an even distribution of water and pressure over the coffee to ensure maximum flavor at up to 15 bars of pressure, giving you a cup of coffee in under a minute. Choose from five flavor varieties. Espresso and caffe lungo require one capsule per beverage of roast and ground Arabica coffee. Cappuccino and latte macchiato require two capsules per beverage: one of Arabica coffee, the other of whole milk and sugar. Chococino uses a capsule for hot chocolate and another for whole milk and sugar.

items.name: sku630210
items.longDescription: Brew loose-leaf tea right in the cup, mess-free. Colorful infuser features inventive wings that pop open to rest on the teacup's rim, then snap closed and seal to catch drips when done steeping. Stainless steel infuser cup. Dishwasher safe.

items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM550017
items.longDescription:
SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.

Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation 

SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.

The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.

The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.

Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.

The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: Introducing our popular 12 inch frame, ready to play your pictures and videos straight out of the box with our easy to use 'plug and play' design. We've equipped it with a generous 4GB memory, housed in a very small and portable USB thumb drive so you can conveniently move photos from your computer to your frame. Combined with a simple, clear remote control, it's a breeze to get started.  Packed with features, the X12B will play your photos (JPEG), videos (MPEG4 / .AVI) and music (MP3), with adjustable slide show settings and also a spilt screen mode to show four photos at once. Photos or videos can both be set to loop, or you can use the timer and alarm and wake up to your favourite memories each day! The timer settings allow you to set the screens up and never need to manually switch them on or off again, whilst never wasting electricity - perfect for commercial use.  Sleek design coupled with plug & play simplicity, this frame is ideal for your home, as a gift or for use as a digital advertising screen.

items.longDescription: With the ability to receive and send photo-mails directly from the frame, a computer becomes unnecessary. No monthly fee is required.   Configuring the frame's Wi-Fi connection is quick and easy and can be done using a few buttons on the compact remote control. Turn on the frame and ensure it is located within reach of the network you want to connect to. The Wi-Fi network configuration is automatically detected and all you need to know is the network password if your Wi-Fi network is encrypted. There is absolutely no software to install. Once configured the frame works without the need for a computer.   It displays beautiful 800 x 600 resolution photos on a big 10 inch screen. Enjoy the best shots of your family in full screen, full resolution.

items.name: DPF1004
items.description: SONY BLACK - GLOSS 15 (16:10) 4 GB DIGITAL PHOTO FRAME 1280X1024 600:1 (NOT WALL MOUNTABLE)
items.longDescription: This 15 inch digital frame is ready to play your pictures and videos straight out of the box with our easy to use 'plug and play' design.  Featuring an inbuilt motion sensor, the frame will turn itself on when it senses any motion and off again when it senses no motion. The motion sensor is very easily set up and can be set to switch off after sensing no movement in time increments from 30 seconds to 1 hour. This frame is perfect for everyone from professionals to parents and grandparents who just want a frame that works with the convenience of not having to actually operate it. As well as its ease of use; the frame features a hi-res SVGA screen with LED back lighting. Importantly the frame will also play your MPEG-4 / .AVI video, JPEG photos. When the frame activates after sensing movement it can play either your photos (from where it left off in the slideshow) or videos. We've equipped it with a generous 4GB memory, housed in a very small and portable USB thumb drive so you can conveniently move photos from your computer to your frame.

items.name: CM50001
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50000
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM550017
items.longDescription:
SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.

Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation 

SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.

The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.

The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.

Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.

The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50002
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50000
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: Sun Dual Port 10 GbE SFP+ PCIe 2.0 networking card with SFP+ pluggable transceiver is designed for the need of the changing data center environments today. Ideal for slot-constrained environments, Sun Dual 10 GbE PCIe 2.0 card provides a simplified low cost alternative to multiple 1 GbE server adapters for Oracle's Sun portfolio of rack and blade servers.Today's multicore environments are driving the need for greater networking bandwidth in order to meet the throughput requirements for virtualized server environments. Offering advanced networking features for efficient distribution of Ethernet workloads across CPU cores, the Sun Dual Port 10 GbE PCIe 2.0 networking cards help to load-balance interrupts and relieve bottlenecks for various high-performance applications in the data center, including iSCSI implementation allowing LAN and storage traffic to share the same network.

items.name: CM53007
items.longDescription: Designed to offer maximum value, the Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter enables the efficient delivery of cost-effective network security to Oracle platforms running Oracle's Solaris operating system.Applications using the SSL protocol can increase transaction protection and performance from the Oracle crypto board. Capable of establishing SSL sessions at up to 13,000 RSA operations per second with 1,024-bit keys and more than 1 Gbps bulk encryption, the Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter efficiently offloads SSL functions and bulk encryption for any application - including IPSec from host processors.The Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter is FIPS 140-2 Level 3 qualified, which means the hardware is tamper protected and tamper evident, and that security parameters never leave the card unencrypted. The Sun Crypto Accelerator 6000 PCIe adapter provides a hardware key store enabling users to safeguard the security parameters on the card. The crypto board also supports financial services-related PIN and credit card verification functionality.

items.name: CM50000
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: Designed to work exclusively with illy iperEspresso capsules, the Francis Francis X7 makes extraordinary espresso with one-touch convenience. Unlike conventional one-stage systems, the iperEspresso method uses an innovative, patented two-stage process to create intensely aromatic, full-bodied espresso with rich, velvety crema that lasts. And because extraction takes place entirely inside the capsule, the coffee and machine never come in contact, making for easy cleanup. Designed by renowned Italian architect Luca Trazzi, this striking machine adds a strong visual statement to any kitchen. Made in Italy.

items.name: sku598979
items.longDescription: The world's slimmest bean-to-cup machine is also simple to use. Streamlined design saves counter space; single-button operation saves you time. Simply press the button to create your customized drink. The variable-volume brewing unit allows you to personalize your coffee amount, strength and temperature, while the height-adjustable spout pours one or two cups at a time with a separate funnel for pre-ground coffee. Conical burr grinder has five settings for desired fineness. Metallic finish on the front adds countertop appeal.  Easily check the machine's status with the text display, which is color-coded for quick reading. Green means it's ready to prepare your coffee, red means it requires action from you, and yellow means it's in programming mode. When inactive, Ena utilizes a Zero Energy Switch that changes over to power-save mode and uses no standby energy. Made in Switzerland.

items.name: sku610170
items.description: Nescafe Dolce Gusto by Krups Caffe Lungo Capsules
items.longDescription: Delicious coffee is easy to prepare and ready in just seconds with these capsules. Pre-measured capsules effortlessly slide into your Krups Nescafe Dolce Gusto system to make a delectable espresso, caffe lungo, cappuccino, latte macchiato or chococino. The capsules deliver an even distribution of water and pressure over the coffee to ensure maximum flavor at up to 15 bars of pressure, giving you a cup of coffee in under a minute. Choose from five flavor varieties. Espresso and caffe lungo require one capsule per beverage of roast and ground Arabica coffee. Cappuccino and latte macchiato require two capsules per beverage: one of Arabica coffee, the other of whole milk and sugar. Chococino uses a capsule for hot chocolate and another for whole milk and sugar.

items.longDescription: Get the temperature ideal for coffee or your favorite tea with the touch of a button. Five preset brewing temperatures include green tea, white tea, oolong tea, French press, and boil and black tea. The 'hold temperature' feature keeps water at the selected temperature for 20 minutes. items.name: sku616482
items.description: Krups Precision Coffee Maker with 12-Cup Glass Carafe
items.longDescription: Twelve-cup coffeemaker with sleek stainless-steel housing and glass carafe looks great on any counter. Features an easy-to-read-and-program control panel and LCD screen that's uniquely angled to face upward. Dual auto-on presets make it possible to wake up to the smell of freshly brewed coffee before work in the morning, as well as at a later time when sleeping in on the weekends. Twelve-cup glass carafe comes with a stay-cool handle and drip-free spout for serving. Maker includes an aroma selection for brewing smaller batches, and an oversized showerhead for improved flavor extraction. A push-button, soft-open lid and auto-lift brew basket makes for easy cleaning. One-year limited warranty.

Fifteen-bar pump pressure ensures perfectly extracted espresso, and ceramic burr grinder with adjustable settings lets you customize your grind. items.name: CM50001
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50000
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.longDescription: Sun Dual Port 10 GbE SFP+ PCIe 2.0 networking card with SFP+ pluggable transceiver is designed for the need of the changing data center environments today. Ideal for slot-constrained environments, Sun Dual 10 GbE PCIe 2.0 card provides a simplified low cost alternative to multiple 1 GbE server adapters for Oracle's Sun portfolio of rack and blade servers.Today's multicore environments are driving the need for greater networking bandwidth in order to meet the throughput requirements for virtualized server environments. Offering advanced networking features for efficient distribution of Ethernet workloads across CPU cores, the Sun Dual Port 10 GbE PCIe 2.0 networking cards help to load-balance interrupts and relieve bottlenecks for various high-performance applications in the data center, including iSCSI implementation allowing LAN and storage traffic to share the same network.

items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM550017
items.longDescription:
SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.

Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation 

SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.

The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.

The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.

Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.

The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50000
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM550017
items.longDescription:
SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.

Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation 

SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.

The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.

The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.

Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.

The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

items.name: CM50000
items.longDescription: SPARC T4 Processor Delivers Performance Boost for a Wide Range of Workloads.Delivers 5x Improvement in Single-Thread Performance Over Previous Generation SPARC T4 Processor Oracle's SPARC T4 processor combines optimized performance on single-threaded and cryptographic workloads with high throughput performance, creating a scalable system-on-a-chip ideal for a wide range of mission-critical applications.The SPARC T4 processor delivers a 5x increase in single-thread performance over the previous generation, while maintaining the high multi-thread throughput performance of Oracle's SPARC T-Series systems. The SPARC T4 processor automatically switches to single-thread mode when only a single thread is active, dedicating all resources to that thread's execution. With faster single-threaded processing, the SPARC T4 enables rapid batch processing along with stunning throughput performance, making it the ideal platform for the consolidation and virtualization of software applications.The SPARC T4 processor was designed from the ground up for high speed security and has a cryptographic stream processing unit (SPU) integrated directly into each processor core. These accelerators support 16 industry standard security ciphers and enable high speed encryption at rates 3 to 5 times that of competing processors. By integrating encryption capabilities directly inside the instruction pipeline, the SPARC T4 processor eliminates the performance and cost barriers typically associated with secure computing and makes it possible to deliver high security levels without impacting the user experience.Integrating system level features such as high-speed 10 GbE networking directly onto the silicon of the SPARC T4 processor drives more efficient application performance and improves system reliability due to reduced part counts in the server.The SPARC T4 processor leverages the unique, no-cost virtualization capabilities of Oracle Solaris Zones and Oracle VM Server for SPARC, enabling customers to run up to 128 domains on a T4-Series server, reducing server space and power requirements, conserving data center space, and minimizing operational complexity.

Tea filters are bleached true flavor filters made of all-natural substances. Includes 100 tea filters per box. Made in Germany. Extra Slim size makes up to two cups. Large size makes up to six cups.

items.longDescription: Years of research have resulted in a technological breakthrough in coffeemaking: air-pressure brewing. Air-pressure brewing shortens filtering time to 20 seconds, avoiding the bitterness of long processes like drip brewing. Air pressure also gently squeezes the last goodness from grounds, further enriching flavor. In addition, our AeroPress espresso maker uses total immersion of grounds in water, resulting in rapid, yet robust extraction of flavor. Makes one to four cups of coffee or espresso in just one minute. Hand wash. Made in USA.

items.name: sku598979
items.longDescription: The world's slimmest bean-to-cup machine is also simple to use. Streamlined design saves counter space; single-button operation saves you time. The variable-volume brewing unit allows you to personalize your coffee amount, strength and temperature, while the height-adjustable spout pours one or two cups at a time with a separate funnel for pre-ground coffee. Conical burr grinder has five settings for desired fineness. Metallic finish on the front adds countertop appeal.  Easily check the machine's status with the text display, which is color-coded for quick reading. Green means it's ready to prepare your coffee, red means it requires action from you, and yellow means it's in programming mode. When inactive, Ena utilizes a Zero Energy Switch that changes over to power-save mode and uses no standby energy. Made in Switzerland.

items.name: sku610188
items.description: Nescafe Dolce Gusto by Krups Espresso Capsules
items.longDescription: Delicious coffee is easy to prepare and ready in just seconds with these capsules. items.name: sku622852

items.longDescription: Get your espresso faster. The 1300-watt stainless steel boiler uses Rapid Steam technology when switching between brewing and steaming. Fifteen-bar pump pressure ensures perfectly extracted espresso, and ceramic burr grinder with adjustable settings lets you customize your grind. Gaggia Milk Island uses steam from the boiler to make automatic cappuccinos and lattes. The 57-oz. water reservoir is removable for easy refill. Made in Italy.
